desc: Read input N, M, S, T and build adjacency list.
Run BFS from S to compute distances `dist_S`.
Run BFS from T to compute distances `dist_T`.
Check if the graph is a simple path between S and T (impossible case).
Compute the minimum operations using the formula and print the result.
Verify the logic with provided samples. Ensure edge cases (e.g., $S, T$ adjacent, small graphs) are handled.
